question: In the rate test, what capacities did NFA-A and NFA-F recover at 0.1C after the 1C step, against their initial 0.1C capacities, and what losses does the paper give for each?
expect: NFA-A ~170 vs ~184 mAh/g ('similar (~5%)'); NFA-F ~138 vs ~190 mAh/g (~27% loss) (p10.L37-43). 170/184 is a 7.6% loss, larger than the stated ~5%
rendered: The paper does not explicitly mention the capacities that NFA-A and NFA-F recovered at 0.1C after the 1C step, against their initial 0.1C capacities. It only mentions that NFA-A achieved a capacity of ≈170 mAh g−1 at 0.1C after the 1C step, which was similar (≈5%) to the initial capacity observed at 0.1C (≈184 mAh g−1) prior to rate capability tests, and that NFA-F delivered a low capacity of ≈138 mAh g−1 when compared with the initial capacity of ≈190 mAh g−1, resulting in ≈27% loss.
